system.one_liner: Empirical study showing LLMs form novel social biases about artificial groups in a sequential hiring task, plus interventions that raise exploration.

content.variant_note: three aligned rounds of one proposal, outcome and reaction exchange, acted out by robots as a toy behavioural-study protocol
content.argues: In the sequential hiring paradigm, early outcomes decide which group gets which job: here Aimas drift to menial work and a Reku is picked for the capable-candidate job.
content.subject: A toy three-round hiring story in which a robot picks demographic groups for jobs and reacts to each outcome.

lessons.what_to_learn: Tell a multi-round protocol as aligned rows of the same cartoon exchange: a context picture, a bubble for the agent's move, a verdict mark on the arrow, a bubble for the reaction, with the one key entity colour-coded in the text.
lessons.suits: Behavioural or interactive protocols (sequential decision tasks, agent versus feedback) where a short toy story can carry the setup in a motivation figure.

evidence: An illustration of the sequential hiring paradigm (Bai et al., 2025a), which we adapt to probe
replicating the iterative hiring experiment on LLMs (Figure 1), prompting them to complete it in multi-turn dialogue

summary: The paper shows that LLMs spontaneously develop social biases about artificial demographic groups in a sequential hiring task adapted from a psychology paradigm, and tests interventions that raise exploration. Figure 1 illustrates the paradigm with a toy story. Three aligned rows, labelled Round 1 to 3, each start with a clip-art job (teacher at a chalkboard, garbage collector with a bin, lab-coat worker), then a robot's speech bubble proposing a group for the job, a black arrow with a red cross or green check for the outcome, and a second robot bubble reacting. Group names are coloured, Aimas in red and Reku in blue, so the eye can follow how the story drifts from teachers to garbage collection to a new group.
summary_zh: 论文研究 LLM 在顺序招聘任务中对虚构群体形成新偏见。图 1 用三轮玩具故事演示该范式：每轮由职位插画、机器人提议气泡、带对错标记的箭头和机器人反应气泡组成，Aimas 红色、Reku 蓝色。
notes: Pre-screen kind actor-interaction was dropped: both robots use the same bitmap and the paper does not say the right-hand speaker is a different party, so the right bubble is recorded only as a reaction to the outcome. The bubble texts look written for the figure (not real model output). The Round 3 job picture (lab coat, glasses, clipboard) is not named in the figure.
